issue_context.summary: PowerToys Runner disappears after hours of ordinary use on multiple systems while the separately hosted Command Palette remains active. Existing diagnostics captured after restarting PowerToys did not identify the exit cause, so a merged Runner telemetry change and a linked preview build are now awaiting a post-recurrence report.
known_information: The original report was filed for PowerToys 0.100.2 installed from the Microsoft Store.
The reporter observed the issue on multiple systems after hours of normal use; the tray icon and other PowerToys tools stopped working while Command Palette stayed active.
The reporter supplied a PowerToys report after noticing the exit and restarting PowerToys.
The maintainer found nothing abnormal in that report and asked whether software had been installed during the exit period; the reporter said no and described only web browsing and video playback.
The reporter later confirmed the same behavior after updating to the latest stable GitHub release.
The reporter linked issues #50270, #49438, and #49208 as similar reports; all three are currently open.
PR #50273 merged on 2026-09-07 and adds logging around Runner WM_QUERYENDSESSION and WM_ENDSESSION handling without changing the existing session-end behavior.
The maintainer first asked the reporter to wait for a preview containing the new logs, then provided preview v0.101.2512.0 and requested another report after the next exit.
The issue remains open, assigned to moooyo, and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, Needs-Team-Response, and Product-General.
inferences: Because Command Palette remains active while the tray-hosted Runner disappears, the failure likely affects the Runner lifecycle rather than every PowerToys process.

A Windows shutdown, sign-out, restart, or Restart Manager close-app message is one plausible explanation, but PR #50273 describes it as a hypothesis and the current public evidence does not confirm it.
The earlier report may not preserve the decisive pre-exit state because it was captured after restarting PowerToys.
issue_context.analysis: The report is credible and sufficiently described to establish an intermittent Runner-lifecycle failure, but it is not deterministic enough to select a behavioral code fix. The repository already contains a merged, issue-linked diagnostic implementation specifically intended to distinguish session-end messages from other exits. Since the maintainer has now supplied the preview and made the exact evidence request, the correct current state is waiting on the reporter rather than proposing a competing design or posting a duplicate comment.
